titulo.estudio: Repérer la grammaire en contexte : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Grammar in the text: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Use articles, pronouns and negation to understand an everyday message. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Use articles, pronouns and negation to understand an everyday message. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: when reading, the definite article can refer to a whole category; pronouns pick up a noun from earlier, and negation changes with the structure. In this passage, «personne» means «nobody».

piezas.titulo: Key words: grammar in the text
